title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 31
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 31: woe to those who trust in Egypt's horses, and Yahweh protecting Jerusalem like hovering birds.

questions.text: Why does the woe fall on those who go down to Egypt for help?
questions.explanation: They rely on horses and trust in chariots and horsemen, but they don't look to the Holy One of Israel or seek Yahweh.

answers.text: They have sold their inheritance for silver
They have forgotten the covenant of their fathers
They rely on horses and chariots but don't seek Yahweh
They have taken wives from the foreign nations

questions.text: What does the chapter say Yahweh will not do with his words?
questions.explanation: He is wise and will bring disaster, and will not call back his words, but will arise against the house of the evildoers.

answers.text: He will not call them back
He will not write them down
He will not speak them to the nations
He will not fulfil them quickly

questions.text: How are the Egyptians and their horses described?
questions.explanation: The Egyptians are men, and not God; their horses are flesh, and not spirit.

answers.text: Strong as the cedars of Lebanon
Men and not God, flesh and not spirit
Swift as eagles and mighty as lions
Many as the sand of the sea

questions.text: How does the lion in the comparison react to the multitude of shepherds called against him?
questions.explanation: As the lion growling over his prey will not be dismayed at their voice nor abase himself for their noise, so Yahweh of Armies will come down to fight.

answers.text: He flees to his den
He divides the prey with them
He waits until night to attack
He is not dismayed at their voice

questions.text: Where will Yahweh of Armies come down to fight?
questions.explanation: Yahweh of Armies will come down to fight on Mount Zion and on its heights.

answers.text: On Mount Zion and on its heights
In the land of Egypt
In the valley of Gibeon
By the brook of Egypt

questions.text: Like what will Yahweh of Armies protect Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: As birds hovering, so Yahweh of Armies will protect Jerusalem; he will protect and deliver it, pass over and preserve it.

answers.text: Like a wall of fire
Like a shepherd with his flock
Like birds hovering
Like a shield and buckler

questions.text: What are the children of Israel urged to do?
questions.explanation: The call is: "Return to him from whom you have deeply revolted, children of Israel."

answers.text: Flee to the mountains and hide themselves
Return to him from whom they have deeply revolted
Keep silence before the nations round about
Send gifts and tribute to the king of Assyria

questions.text: What will everyone cast away in that day?
questions.explanation: In that day everyone will cast away his idols of silver and his idols of gold, sin which their own hands made.

answers.text: Their weapons of war
Their garments of mourning
Their foreign alliances
Their idols of silver and gold

questions.text: By what will the Assyrian fall?
questions.explanation: The Assyrian will fall by the sword, not of man; the sword, not of mankind, will devour him.

answers.text: By famine within his camp
By the sword, not of man
By the hand of Pharaoh
By fire from the sky

questions.text: Where does Yahweh have his fire and his furnace?
questions.explanation: The chapter ends with Yahweh, "whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem."

answers.text: His fire in Zion and his furnace in Jerusalem
His fire in the heavens and his furnace in the deep
His fire on Carmel and his furnace on Sinai
His fire in the temple and his furnace in the valley
